messages:
Rosa (Design): Quick sync — proposing a 'strip ribbon' between the timepicker and heatmap: shows p95 sparkline + throughput mini-bars. Goal: scan-and-jump. Thoughts?
Ben (Frontend): Nice. Concern about cramped layout at narrow widths. Suggest collapse icon to hide bars.
Asha (Product): Key: jump-to-range + simple pin. Ops should be able to jump from ribbon to scrubber in one click.
Mark (A11y): Accessibility: hover-only actions bad. Make chevron focusable, aria-label='Jump to interval', and provide keyboard shortcut.
Kai (Eng Runtime): Backend can produce 1min aggregates. We'll add ?resolution=60s and severity tag for spikes.
Rosa (Design): Proposal: condensed legend with colorblind-safe palette and small p50/p95 markers.
Ben (Frontend): Implementation: render ribbon on canvas, add SVG overlays for interactions to keep DOM small.
Mark (A11y): Canvas must have an offscreen text summary when focused: "p50 90ms, p95 420ms, throughput 230r/s". Tooltip delay 300ms.
Asha (Product): Copy: use 'Spike detected' badge instead of 'Anomaly'. Add severity levels in badge text.
Ben (Frontend): For ultra-compact mode, use longpress on touch and explicit 'Pin' in overflow menu for keyboard.
Kai (Eng Runtime): We'll cap pinned intervals per user to 5 and return pinned metadata.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: design-proto/strip-ribbon v1 -> staging at 2024-10-02T16:00Z :rocket:
Rosa (Design): Next: Ben protos canvas, Mark writes a11y spec, Kai adds endpoint, Asha updates PRD. I'll attach Figma by EOD tomorrow.
